attribute_provenance.statutory_policy_test: Benchmark Challenge 8 & Challenge 4 (Area Limit & Unknown Title Handling): Large holding of 12.5 acres (> 10.0 ac); requested subsidized area of 4.80 ha strictly satisfies physical parcel capacity (4.80 ha <= 12.5 ac * 0.404686 = 5.0586 ha) and statutory ceiling (4.80 ha <= 5.00 ha) under PMKSY-PDMC Guidelines 2023 §7.9 (assistance capped at 5.0 ha per beneficiary); 7-year repeat restriction satisfied by explicit first-time applicant declaration (null mapped to PMKSY_NO_PRIOR_SUBSIDY). RAW-ENGINE VS GOVERNANCE DISCREPANCY: The raw engine compares total operational holding against 12.35 ac and returns INELIGIBLE (PMKSY_LAND_ABOVE_5_HA). However, §7.9 caps the subsidized assistance area rather than imposing a blanket disqualification on the entire holding. CRITICAL GOVERNANCE SAFEGUARD: Because land title record date is UNKNOWN (land_ownership_cutoff_pre_feb_2019 = None), three-valued logic is strictly preserved: governance places determination in Section B as REQUIRES_VERIFICATION without numerical scoring pending title regularization. PM-KISAN similarly preserves REQUIRES_VERIFICATION in Section B due to the 01.02.2019 cut-off date check, distinguished from PMKSY's title and layout documentation requirements. SMAM and KCC Central qualify in Section A; grid connection excludes PM-KUSUM B; existing borewell and wetland topography exclude Ganga Kalyana.
